written.explainPrompt: Why is the mean diameter used to calculate the length for an eye?
written.explainGuide: When the bar bends, the inside compresses and the outside stretches. Only the centre line keeps its length, so the mean diameter gives the true length.

written.explainPrompt: Why is the slant height used as the radius in developing a cone?
written.explainGuide: The surface of the cone runs along the slant from apex to base. When flattened, every point on the base is one slant height from the apex, so it is the radius.
